id.description: ID of the project whose sprints will be listed — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list_in_project, get)

filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.

Accepts the same format and filters as returned by the [sprints](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/sprints/) endpoint. (operations: list_in_project, list)

offset.description: Page number inside the requested collection. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list_in_project, list)

pageSize.description: Number of elements to display per page. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list_in_project, list)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
